'''Anatoli Mikaelevich Rubinov''' ({{Langx|be|Анатоль Мікалаевіч Рубінаў}}) is a politician from [[Belarus]] who served as Speaker of [[Council of the Republic (Belarus)|Council of the Republic]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Lansford |first=Tom |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=PdWTBwAAQBAJ&dq=Anatoli+Rubinov+speaker&pg=PA132 |title=Political Handbook of the World 2015 |date=2015-03-24 |publisher=CQ Press |isbn=978-1-4833-7158-0 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last1=Lansford |first1=Tom |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=d33MfEFXvW8C&dq=Anatoli+Rubinov+speaker&pg=PA126 |title=Political Handbook of the World 2012 |last2=Muller |first2=Tom |date=2012-04-02 |publisher=SAGE |isbn=978-1-60871-995-2 |language=en}}</ref> In 2015, he stepped down from his post.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-01-16 |title=Rubinov steps down as Speaker of Council of Republic |url=https://eng.belta.by/politics/view/rubinov-steps-down-as-speaker-of-council-of-republic-9584-2015 |access-date=2022-11-27 |website=Belarusian Telegraph Agency |language=en-EN}}</ref>
